articleTitle: Research on dynamic adaptation of English translation based on deep reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: This research is dedicated to exploring the application of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) in dynamic adaptability of English translation. This study compared traditional sequence-to-sequence models, models using attention mechanisms, and advanced models integrating deep reinforcement learning to assess their impact on improving machine translation quality. The research found the deep reinforcement learning model significantly outperforms other models across key performance indicators like BLEU score, accuracy, and recall, particularly for complex translation tasks and maintaining contextual coherence. While deep reinforcement learning models perform well, their high computational demands and potential generalization issues also emerged as limitations. Overall, the study highlights the potential of deep reinforcement learning to adapt in dynamic environments and its promising impact on machine translation. The conclusions of this study provide strong evidence for the application of deep reinforcement learning technology in improving the performance of machine translation systems, and provide suggestions for future research directions and model optimization.

articleTitle: WLAN anti-interference for high-voltage overhead transmission lines based on comprehensive sensing of spectral posture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: With the development of wireless communication technology, wireless communication is gradually used in monitoring data transmission of HV transmission lines, but there are some problems such as strong electromagnetic interference in data transmission and throughput decline of users at the edge of the interval. To solve this problem, an anti-interference technology based on spectrum situation comprehensive perception is proposed, the spectrum detection results of all nodes are equally analyzed and decided, the advanced interval interference coordination technology is used to allocate network resources, the interference is divided into static and dynamic types, and the edge band occupancy rate is used to coordinate interference. The experimental results show that the average user throughput of the advanced interval interference coordination technology is 0.71Mbps and 0.21Mbps higher than that of other algorithms in the solid state scene, and the maximum convergence value of the advanced interval interference coordination technology is 13 and 5 higher than that of other algorithms, respectively. The average user throughput of the advanced interval interference coordination technique is 0.19Mbps and 0.13Mbps higher than other algorithms, respectively. Thus, interference coordination can effectively improve the performance of edge users, accurately predict the user's access base station, and reduce the impact of electromagnetic interference. This study provides a reference for the interference coordination of the cell in the future wireless LAN anti-jamming technology.

articleTitle: Research on prediction method of surrounding rock deformation of highway tunnel based on optimized Bayesian algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low prediction accuracy and poor generalization ability of the current tunnel surrounding rock deformation, this paper proposes a method based on Bayesian optimization long short-term memory network (LSTM). This method first analyzes the vault settlement Preprocess the original monitoring data of the highway tunnel vault settlement and peripheral convergence, and then construct an initial LSTM model of the highway tunnel vault settlement and peripheral convergence, and use Bayes to optimize the hyperparameters in the model to finally obtain the prediction results.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Deep Learning in Data Processing of Financial High Frequency Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: High-Frequency Trading (HFT) in finance is characterized by its high speed, frequency, and short holding periods, playing a crucial role in modern financial markets while also facing challenges such as high data noise, high dimensionality, and complex dynamics. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid model combining Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTM) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), optimized with Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for trading strategies. LSTM is utilized to capture long-term trends and cyclical features in market data, whereas CNN extracts local features of short-term price fluctuations. Experimental results validate the superiority of this hybrid model in predicting financial market movements, particularly excelling in classification tasks with high accuracy and robustness. Compared to traditional machine learning methods like Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Random Forests, deep learning (DL) models handle complex patterns and nonlinear relationships within high-dimensional time series data more effectively. Furthermore, the optimization through DRL leads to more intelligent trading strategies, enhancing the overall system performance. This study provides significant reference and insights for the application of DL in handling HFT data in the financial domain.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on the Operation Model and Economic Market Mechanism of User Side Integrated Light-Storage- Charging Project
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: This article proposes an economic calculation method for user side integrated light storage and charging projects. Based on the high granularity data of 8760 hours of actual mining load, a total of the 35040 units are collected every 15 minutes. An accurate economic calculation model for coupling wind and solar energy storage and charging multiple energy factors is constructed to achieve overall estimation of the new energy in the early stage and expected operating income calculation. After preliminary determination, the investment return curves for different energy storage capacities can be obtained under the conditions of 1073kW charging pile and 600kWp photovoltaic capacity. When the energy storage configuration capacity is greater than 200kWh, 300kWh, and 400kWh, the IRR of the energy storage portion of the project's revenue is negative. Integrated projects rely entirely on light and partial revenue to compensate for the energy storage losses, and it is better to allocate less energy. When the energy storage configuration is 0kWh, the maximum internal rate of return of the project is 9.96%, and the payback period is 7.33 years. The construction investment for the Ben-guang storage and charging project is 3.445 million yuan, with an initial investment of 689000 yuan in self owned capital. The total investment return rate of the project is 6.49%, the internal rate of return is 9.40%, and the investment payback period is 7.58 years. It has certain profitability, with an average debt coverage ratio of 1.42 and an average interest coverage ratio of 6.25. It has the ability to repay debts and is generally economically feasible. To meet maximization of benefits for photovoltaic storage and charging projects, and taking into account the difference between photovoltaic output and the user load, as well as certain poor storage benefits, it is recommended that the storage capacity of this project be 100kW or less.

articleTitle: Recommendation algorithm for agricultural and sideline products on e-commerce platforms based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy in e-commerce platform recommendation of agricultural and sideline products, an agricultural and sideline product recommendation algorithm based on deep learning was studied. Fully analyze the problems existing in the process of recommending agricultural and sideline products, study the mechanism of item-based collaborative filtering algorithm, and combine the document topic and matrix decomposition hybrid algorithm. Highlighting the advantages of both, a topic weighted fusion collaborative filtering algorithm was formed. Through experiments, this algorithm can effectively improve the recommendation effect of agricultural and sideline products on e-commerce platforms. Compared with the simple item collaborative filtering algorithm, the algorithm studied in this study can effectively improve the accuracy of recommended targets by about 5%, and also has a 2% improvement in the diversity of recommended targets. In terms of accuracy of prediction results, through experimental comparison, the root mean square error of this algorithm is also lower than other comparative algorithms, which proves the advantages of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Storage Economy of User Side Photovoltaic Configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: This article takes 8760 hours of load data from certain region as the research object, and quantitatively analyzes the characteristics of the 12 month monthly load curve and the 24 hour daily load curve throughout the year. The monthly load curve can effectively display the peak load of the year occurs between July and November, which is during the peak summer season. The 24-hour daily load curve indicates that the low load occurs at 8:00 am, 13:00 noon, and 8:00 pm, and load rapidly increases from 8:00 to 11:00 pm until entering the noon peak period at 12:00 pm. On the other hand, the output characteristic curve of photovoltaic power generation was analyzed, and it was found that there is a single or double peak characteristic in the photovoltaic output curve, with peak appearing between 5am and 5pm. Photovoltaic power generation curve can effectively support the output of the load curve. Based on the load characteristic curve and photovoltaic power generation curve, the yield analysis of light storage configuration is conducted: the light intensity is based on the average daily hourly rate in the past three years, and the load curve is based on the average daily hourly rate of 15 minutes in past year. Choose "two charge and two discharge" charging and discharging strategy for energy storage, that is, once during valley charging and discharging, and once during flat charging and discharging. Select a company with a relatively regular and smooth load curve as the case analysis object, with an average power of about 2000kW, an average standard deviation of 491kW, and average standard deviation coefficient of 0.36<1. Through the established calculation model, the yield curve of PV installed capacity is obtained. As the installed capacity of the photovoltaic projects gradually increases, the yield of photovoltaic projects shows a gradual downward trend. When the installed capacity is less than 1.5MW, the decline trend of yield is relatively gentle. When the installed capacity is greater than 1.5MW, the decline trend of yield becomes more severe. From this, it can be determined that when the optimal installed capacity is around 1.5MW, the yield is 9.37%, in order to achieve highest yield and maximum photovoltaic power generation.

Author Keywords: Photovoltaic power generation output characteristic curve

articleTitle: Civil Aviation Passenger Throughput Forecasting Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: This article examines a predictive model for estimating civil aviation passenger traffic using the long short-term memory network (LSTM). Analyzing the historical flight data, meteorological data, and holiday information of an international airport between 2010 and 2020 helped create a forecasting model that effectively captures the long-term dependency of time series data. The process of preparing data includes removing data, filling in missing values, and standardizing data, and then combining multi-dimensional data with feature engineering to improve data quality. The outcomes of the study show that the LSTM model performs reliably on the training and validation data, obtaining an MSE of 0.35, RMSE of 0.59, and MAE of 0.48.This suggests that the model possesses strong prediction accuracy and generalization capabilities. The study in this paper confirms the efficiency of the LSTM model in predicting civil aviation passenger throughput, offers dependable decision-making support for airport management and flight scheduling, and enhances the model's performance by employing proper data processing and feature selection strategies.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Chemical Processes Based on PSO-GCN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: As industrial production advances, ensuring process safety and minimizing failure-related losses is crucial. Detecting abnormal conditions efficiently is key. To address the complexity, high dimensionality, nonlinearity, and time-varying nature of chemical process data, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN). The method denoises the data, constructs a graph using a sliding window, and uses PSO to optimize the diagnostic model's parameters and extract features. These features are then classified via a fully connected layer and classifier. Experimental results show that the method outperforms other machine learning and deep learning approaches in accuracy and precision, and excels at detecting minor faults in chemical processes.

articleTitle: Fingerprint-Based Training and Evaluation on Hierarchical Temporal Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: In spiking neural networks and biologically realistic simulation neural networks, Hierarchical Temporal Memory (HTM) has been proposed, yet it encounters challenges related to storage capacity. This study introduces an enhancement to the training process, which modifies the dendrite weights based on the evaluation of hash performance and the achievement of learning and recognition. The training process is optimized through the bionic hashing mechanism of BioHash, utilizing the Energy function to assess the payload of HTM modules. This assessment facilitates the distribution of storage requirements among different modules. On the CIFAR-10 dataset, we conducted classification tests using the proposed Hash-HTM with different fingerprint size of hashes, demonstrating a significant improvement at long hash cases in accuracy to illustrate the effectiveness of the storage enhancement.

articleTitle: The Application of AI Video Generation Technology in Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: AI has become one of the key forces driving social progress, particularly in the fields of VR and AR, where the application of AI video generation technology is spearheading a technological revolution. This article delves into the specific applications, potential impacts, and future development trends of AI video generation technology in VR and AR. VR technology enables users to fully immerse themselves and interact with virtual environments. AR technology, on the other hand, overlays virtual information onto the real world, integrating virtual objects and information into the user's actual surroundings. AI video generation technology plays a crucial role in these two domains. In the VR sector, AI video generation technology, leveraging deep learning techniques, can learn and mimic human creative styles, automatically generating video content. Through image processing and machine learning technologies, this article explores how AI can generate high-quality virtual objects and scenes, making them more realistic and seamlessly integrated with the real world. Additionally, this article analyzes the challenges and opportunities faced by AI video generation technology in VR and AR applications, such as technological bottlenecks, data privacy, and security issues. AI video generation technology is poised to play an increasingly significant role in the VR and AR sectors.

articleTitle: Effective Radius Prediction Method for Gas Extraction Based on Adam+DNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: With the widespread application of artificial intelligence and intelligent algorithms in the industrial field, predicting the effective radius of gas extraction has become an important topic for improving mine safety and resource utilization efficiency. A method for predicting the effective radius of gas extraction based on a combined intelligent model has been proposed. The results showed that the Adam optimizer rapidly converged to 0.02 in the validation set loss value at a learning rate of 0.001 and remained stable. Further testing showed that the deviation between the predicted values and the true values of the proposed model was 1.5m, 0.6m, and 0.3m for samples 2, 4, and 10 in the first set of data, and 0.7m and 1.0m for samples 7 and 8 in the second set of data, respectively. Overall, the fit was good. In practical applications, the relative error between predicted results and measured values ranges from 1% to 6%. Therefore, the adaptability and high accuracy of the model under multi mine conditions provide an intelligent prediction tool for the effective radius evaluation of mine gas extraction process.

articleTitle: Psychological State Assessment and Training Optimization of Tennis Players Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: The emotional state of a person is complex and subtle, often expressed subtly through various nonverbal means such as facial expressions, gestures, and tone of voice. However, in practical situations, these emotional signals are often difficult to directly observe or be intentionally or unintentionally misled, making accurate identification of an individual’s true psychological state a challenge. With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) technology, deep learning (DL), as one of its core driving forces, has shown unprecedented potential and advantages in multiple fields, including sports science. This paper proposes a DL based psychological state assessment algorithm for tennis players, a high-level competitive group that highly relies on psychological qualities. This algorithm utilizes DL technology to deeply analyze athletes' facial expressions, body language changes, and physiological index fluctuations during competitions, thereby achieving accurate evaluation of athletes' psychological states. Based on the evaluation results, personalized training programs can be further tailored for tennis players. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can accurately evaluate the psychological state of athletes and improve their psychological adaptability and competition performance.

articleTitle: Model Construction and Application of Artificial Intelligence in Improving the Efficiency of Ideological and Political Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: In recent years, with the vigorous rise of cutting-edge technologies such as big data analysis, machine learning (ML), and cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI) technology is penetrating into various fields of society at an unprecedented speed, among which higher education has undergone profound and extensive changes. This change is not only reflected in the innovation of teaching methods, but also deeply touches on the renewal of educational concepts and the improvement of educational quality. This article innovatively proposes an AI based efficiency improvement model for ideological and political education (IPE), which fully utilizes big data analysis capabilities to deeply mine and insight into students' learning behavior, interest preferences, and ideological dynamics, providing personalized and differentiated teaching content recommendations for IPE. At the same time, combined with ML algorithms, real-time monitoring and warning of students' ideological dynamics can be achieved, and potential ideological deviations can be detected and intervened in a timely manner. The experimental results show that the model significantly improves students' learning interest and participation, and students have achieved significant results in mastering IPE theoretical knowledge, improving their ideological and moral qualities, and cultivating their sense of social responsibility.

Author Keywords: Efficiency of ideological and political education

articleTitle: Multimodal Physiological Signal Emotion Recognition Method Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: Prior research in emotion recognition has mainly concentrated on examining physiological signals from a single modality, such as electroencephalogram (EEG) or various peripheral physiological signals (PPS). However, given the multimodal nature of human emotional expression, these unimodal methodologies fail to reach satisfactory accuracy. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a multimodal emotion recognition approach utilizing the attention mechanism (MERA), consisting of both a unimodal feature extraction module and a multimodal feature fusion module. During the unimodal feature extraction phase, we investigate the complex interactions among various channels and employ an encoder module to precisely capture the subtle distinctions in emotional fluctuations. In the multimodal feature fusion phase, a multi-head attention mechanism is employed to emphasize the complementary nature of various modalities and the complex interplay among signals through dynamic weighting, thereby enhancing the accuracy of emotion recognition. Experiments carried out on the DEAP and MAHNOB-HCI datasets reveal superior outcomes for our method in binary and four-class emotion classification tasks across various frequency bands. Our framework outperforms contemporary leading approaches in terms of accuracy for all types of classification.

articleTitle: Online Education Intelligent Performance Prediction Model Based on Logistics Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: With the rapid development of online education, a large number of students' online learning behavior data is stored. Based on the online learning behavior of students, the prediction of teaching performance can effectively identify students who are at risk of learning, thus helping educators to provide learning assistance for such students. It can improve their learning performance and ensure the quality of online learning. However, at present, the inductive methods of predicting factors of academic performance are relatively simple, and there is a general lack of standardized data selection methods. The perspective of academic performance prediction is often curriculum-centered, and the curriculum often ignores the dominant position of students. Therefore, a deep knowledge tracking model combining a multi-feature model and performance prediction was proposed in the paper. The traditional single prediction model is planned into a feature set. Through integrating a plurality of teaching indexes, a plurality of feature sets is innovatively input into the model for feature processing. The optimized regression algorithm performs correction after establishing the weight to ensure the accuracy of the prediction result. Finally, a simulation experiment environment is set up. The comparative test results indicate that the prediction accuracy of the proposed model is higher than that of the single data prediction algorithm. Compared with the traditional prediction algorithm, the prediction accuracy is 92. 4% and 89. 1%, respectively. The results of this study judge the quality of students' online learning through useful information and provide empirical evidence for online learning platforms to improve students' learning effectiveness. The use of network behavior information and interactive information to improve the learning effect provides auxiliary significance.

articleTitle: Intelligent Grain, Oil and Food Processing Equipment: AI-Based Fault Diagnosis and Predictive Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: The rapid development of AI technology has made its application in the grain, oil and food processing industry more and more extensive, especially in equipment fault diagnosis and predictive maintenance shows great potential. The traditional maintenance of food processing equipment often relies on empirical judgment and regular maintenance, which has the disadvantages of lagging response, high maintenance cost and long downtime. AI-based fault diagnosis and predictive maintenance technology, however, collects equipment operation data in real time through an integrated sensor network, and analyzes the data characteristics using machine learning algorithms to realize real-time monitoring of equipment status and fault prediction. This paper introduces the basic principles of AI in fault diagnosis, including key steps such as data collection and processing, feature extraction, model building and prediction result evaluation. In addition, this paper analyzes how AI can identify potential failure modes and formulate maintenance plans in advance by analyzing equipment operation data, thus effectively reducing unplanned downtime and maintenance costs. AI-based fault diagnosis and predictive maintenance technology has revolutionized the grain, oil and food processing industry, which not only improves production efficiency and guarantees product quality, but also significantly reduces maintenance costs. The research results of this paper have practical value for promoting the intelligent upgrading of the grain, oil and food processing industry.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection Algorithm of Mechanical Vibration Fault Based on Multi-sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: In this paper, firstly, the multi-sensor fusion technology is deeply analyzed, and combined with Deep learning (DL) technology, an intelligent fault detection model suitable for multi-sensor fusion data is constructed, and it is described in detail. According to the characteristics of mechanical vibration signal, the lifting Wavelet transformation (WT) is applied to the purification and denoising of axis trajectory on the basis of studying the principle of wavelet threshold denoising. The existing wavelet filter is decomposed into basic building blocks, the integer transform of wavelet is completed step by step, the wavelet coefficients are extracted more efficiently, the signal and noise are effectively separated, and the accurate reconstruction is realized. Then, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation research, and compared with the existing methods, which proves the superiority of the proposed algorithm in fault diagnosis accuracy and robustness. Simulation results show that the fault detection algorithm proposed in this paper performs well in accuracy, recall and F1 score. Compared with the traditional wavelet, the wavelet in this paper can suppress the noise and retain the signal characteristics to the maximum extent in signal denoising. It is expected that the work in this paper can contribute to solving practical problems in the field of mechanical vibration fault detection, and provide useful reference and enlightenment for researchers and engineers in related fields.

articleTitle: Military Training Risk Assessment Model Assisted by Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: This article aims to build a risk assessment model of military training based on algorithm, so as to accurately identify and assess the risk factors in military training and provide scientific and objective decision support for training departments. In order to achieve this goal, this study systematically sorts out and analyzes the risk factors in military training, and establishes a complete risk assessment index system. On this basis, the fuzzy neural network (FNN) algorithm is innovatively applied to build a military training risk assessment model, and a large number of historical data and expert opinions are used for training and optimization. The experimental results show that the model can accurately assess the risk factors in military training and output the corresponding risk level, which is close to the expert assessment results. This study provides a new scientific method and technical support for the safety management of military training. In the future, the model structure will be further optimized to improve the accuracy and generalization ability of the model, so as to better serve the risk assessment and safety management of military training.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Optimizing Intangible Cultural Heritage Artistic Creation Process Using Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of big data and artificial intelligence (AI) technology, traditional artistic design has experienced profound impacts, especially in the field of image generation artistic creation. The application of AI not only provides new creative tools but also broadens the forms and contents of artistic expression. Against this backdrop, this paper focuses on studying how to effectively apply AI technology in the process of intangible cultural heritage artistic creation, overcoming the limitations of humans in the creative process. Through AI technology's learning of images related to intangible cultural heritage art, this research can generate images with traditional artistic styles, exploring how to use AI to assist artists in creation, including image generation, detail optimization, and style transfer, among others. Finally, this research evaluates the practical application effect of AI technology in intangible cultural heritage artistic creation, analyzes its degree of optimization for the creative process, and hopes to find a balance between AI technology and intangible cultural heritage artistic creation. This not only contributes to the inheritance and innovation of intangible cultural heritage art but also injects new vitality into modern artistic design.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Methods for Power System Slice Sensitivity Calculation and Presentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: With the large amount of renewable energy access, the dynamic characteristics and operation mode of the power system have changed, and more advanced section sensitivity analysis is needed to ensure the stable operation of the system. The optimization calculation method can help the system adapt to the volatility and uncertainty of renewable energy. In view of this, this paper studies the optimization method of section sensitivity calculation and display for the change of dynamic characteristics and operation mode of power system under the background of large-scale access of renewable energy. By analyzing the application of DC power flow method, Jacobian matrix method and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm in section sensitivity calculation, the performance of different algorithms in IEEE-10 node system is compared. The results show that PSO algorithm has advantages in reducing network loss and improving computing efficiency, and provides strong support for efficient and stable operation of power system.

articleTitle: E-commerce hybrid recommendation algorithm based on user dynamic interests
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: Aiming at the information overload problem in e-commerce, a hybrid recommendation algorithm for e-commerce based on users' dynamic interests was studied. In the construction process of this algorithm, the user's dynamic interest factors are integrated to make the recommended results more time-effective. The combination of forgetting curve and feature construction is used to form a recommendation algorithm with dynamic characteristics. The recall rate, classification accuracy rate and F1 parameter are selected as the evaluation indicators of the model, and the indicators are compared with the LR, FR and GBDT algorithms. It can be seen from the results that, except for the classification accuracy, there is not much difference between the four algorithms, in terms of recall rate and F1 parameter, the algorithm of this study is better than the other three comparison algorithms, proving that the algorithm has good performance. It can be used to recommend products of user interest in e-commerce.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Content Recognition for News Images and Videos
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: The popularization of mobile Internet represented by 5G has led to the increasing diversification of news content dissemination, and news images and videos have become one of the main carriers of information dissemination. However, the explosive growth in the number of news images and videos makes how to efficiently and accurately recognize their contents a major challenge for the news industry. To this end, this paper delves into deep learning-based content recognition techniques for news images and videos, aiming to ameliorate the intelligence of news content processing. This paper first explores the utilization of deep learning in news image recognition, and realizes the automatic extraction and classification of key information in news images by constructing CNN and other models, which effectively ameliorates the accuracy and efficiency of image recognition. In addition, this paper also studies the design and optimization process of the deep learning model, and finally verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method. The validation results show that the deep learning-based news image and video content recognition technology can significantly ameliorate the recognition accuracy and provide strong support for the automated processing of news content. In summary, the deep learning-based news image and video content recognition technology proposed in this paper has important theoretical and practical utilization value.

articleTitle: Research on Aircraft Automated Mesh Generation Software
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: Grid automation is widely used in finite element analysis, computational fluid dynamics and other fields. Its core lies in accurately dividing complex geometries into suitable grids for numerical calculations. To solve the existing problems, this paper develops an automated grid generation software based on the Gmsh library. The software simplifies the user interface, optimizes the handling of boundary layers and complex geometries, reduces manual intervention, and is easy to use for non-professional users. The results show that the software can generate grids faster and better in complex engineering simulations, and also supports fast iteration.

articleTitle: Intelligent Classification Model of Oroqen Music Style Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: This study applies deep learning toward building an intelligent identification model for the Oroqen music style, classifying, and recognizing the Oroqen traditional music style. A rich Oroqen music corpus was built by collecting existing audio materials. After pre-processing and feature extraction, these data are going to generate signal and Mel spectrograms, as well as MFCC characteristics, which are good to enter deep learning models. The Mel spectrogram is selected as the basis for this model, and the choice and design of the CNN architecture are followed; then, the whole process of data preprocessing, feature extraction, model training, and evaluation is combined to build the intelligent classification system. Experimental results showed that the proposed model performed well for most evaluation indicators, with a rate of 92% for accuracy, 91% for precision, and 90% for recall, while the harmonic F1 measure was 90%. It will therefore be able to effectively classify the music materials for Oroqen and archive them, so as to improve their culture and meanwhile be used as a reference by other studies regarding the ethnic music.

articleTitle: Personalized and similarity contrast federated learning on non-IId
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: Data heterogeneity is a major challenge in federated learning. This paper introduces FedKSA, a personalized approach that extends FedKD to handle non-iid data. FedKSA integrates an adaptive local aggregation module in client models for dynamic global and local updates tailored to each client's objectives. It uses gradient-based clustering during model aggregation to reduce data distribution differences, enhancing performance. Experiments across diverse datasets and environments show FedKSA effectively mitigates data heterogeneity, outperforming original and baseline methods with up to 1.84% and 45.22% increases in test accuracy, respectively.

articleTitle: On Big Data in Weibo: Dynamic Data Analysis Based on Mathematical Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: As a barometer of Chinese online public opinion, Sina Weibo generates huge amounts of data every day with the emergence of hot topics. A mathematical model of partial differential equations with time variables has been introduced to study the dynamic changes in Weibo data. The purpose of this article is to track and analyze data related to two hot topics: the surge in gas prices in Chengdu and Chongqing. Through preliminary analysis, a mathematical model based on the characteristics of changes over time has been established, namely the nonlocal integrable equation, specifically the nonlocal Kadomtsev-Petviashvili equation with the fundamental partial-rogue ripple lump chain solution. By selecting an appropriate solution, this model simulates and explains the full-cycle evolution mechanism of these two hot topics as they erupt simultaneously, influence each other, and ultimately merge into one. These research findings facilitate an understanding of the dynamic changes in massive Weibo data.

articleTitle: Digital course scheduling system for data-driven industrial worker training based on 5G enabling environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: 5G wisdom on the basis of digital campus, campus under the effective use of 5G technology of Internet of things, cloud computing, big data and other advanced information engineering to carry out a full range of campus construction, promoting the scientific decision-making, build open teaching environment, good for all the teachers and students to provide more convenient and comfortable place to live, work, study<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. This article mainly around college students online course management system implementation technology selection, system requirements, database design and so on carries on the analysis, thus the college students' course selection management system based on B/S structure, B/S architecture to implement development, convenient maintenance, and to implement low cost price, so as to achieve high efficiency low cost development, the main functional modules of the system are: Student and teacher information management, user rights control, course management, classroom management, class management, course selection management, class withdrawal, course selection statistics management, students, teachers and school administrators only need to click on the browser to access the system can carry out the corresponding course selection and system management and maintenance, Java programming language and popular frameworks such as Spring Boot, Bootstrap and some Ajax technologies are selected to achieve the smoothness of data interaction at the front and back end of the system. With the advent of the Internet era, the birth of Internet +<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>, which can be added to a large number, gradually adds every bit of life, there is no doubt that education has always been a hot issue in the world.

articleTitle: Application of English semantic understanding in multimodal machine learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: This article explores the application of English semantic understanding in multi-modal machine learning, especially focusing on the two core tasks of sentiment analysis and information retrieval. By conducting experiments on the public multimodal datasets CMU-MOSI and Flickr30k, this study evaluates the performance difference between multimodal methods that integrate text, image, and audio information and single-modal methods. Experimental results show that the multi-modal method significantly improves the accuracy in the sentiment analysis task, reaching 90%. In the information retrieval task, the multi-modal method also shows higher precision, recall and F1 score. . These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of multimodal learning in improving the model's ability to understand complex English semantics. In addition, this article also discusses the future research directions of multimodal technology in the field of English semantic understanding, including exploring more advanced modal fusion technology, developing robust multimodal models, and improving the transparency and interpretability of the model.

articleTitle: Garbage Classification System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of garbage classification, this paper developed a garbage classification system in the form of mini program. The Huawei Cloud garbage classification competition dataset is used for this system. The PaddlePaddle framework is used to train the classification model for garbage classification. The garbage classification system can meet the users' demand for garbage image query, and this system is simple and easy to use. It is of great significance to the implementation of garbage classification policy.

articleTitle: JAVA Mobile Application Development Course Under the Framework of Industry-Education Integration: Practice of Deep Learning and Neural Network Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: The popularization of AI technology, yes the emerging technology represented by deep learning and neural network has gradually become an important tool for solving complex problems. Specifically, in the application field of mobile application development, the cutting-edge deep learning technology is integrated into the JAVA mobile application development course by utilizing the teaching mode of industry-teaching fusion to cultivate students' innovative ability and practical ability. This paper first analyzes the current market demand and technology trends in the mobile application development industry, and points out the great potential of deep learning and neural network technology in enhancing application intelligence and personalization. It describes how to introduce deep learning framework and neural network model in JAVA mobile application development course, and analyzes how to realize deep learning applications such as image recognition, emotion analysis and speech recognition in mobile applications. Under the background of the integration of industry and education, students can be provided with learning resources and internship opportunities that are closer to reality through the deep cooperation with industry enterprises. The research in this paper can provide useful practical reference for the teaching reform of mobile application development courses in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of machine Vision of AI based intelligent robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: With the progress of science and technology, intelligence has become an inevitable trend of the development of today's society. As a representative of intelligent technology, intelligent robots have high research value. The purpose of this study is to deeply explore the key technologies of machine vision and data fusion of intelligent robots based on AI, and improve the holographic depth perception, decision-making and execution capabilities of intelligent robots. Path planning is a basic and important problem in mobile robot research. Based on the research of robot vision, this paper proposes a vision-based real-time obstacle avoidance and navigation control algorithm for autonomous mobile robot, which has been implemented on GIAA-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. Through the application of full vision technology, this study successfully realized the high-precision positioning and autonomous navigation of intelligent mobile robot in complex environment. Experimental results show that the positioning accuracy of the system reaches centimeter level, and the navigation stability is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Model of Converter Transformer Output Device Based on Real-time Inversion Calculation of Transient Temperature and E-field of HVDC Bushing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: The technical conditions and main performance indicators of the outlet bushing of ±800kV ultra-high voltage converter transformer are important basis for its insulation structure design. The equalizing ring, conductive tube, and oil equalizing ball are all of high potential, and the rated voltage of output bushing of the ±800kV ultra-high voltage converter transformer is 844kV (DC phase to ground 721kV, AC phase to ground 123kV). The elevated seat, the connecting flange, the earth and far-field boundary are at zero potential. When the ±800kV ultra-high voltage output bushing operates at the rated voltage, the central conductor heats up due to carrying the large DC current, and the oil temperature of the transformer inside the converter is also high. Research has shown that during operation of the converter transformer bushing, the temperature of the central conductor can reach 90°, the oil temperature in the transformer riser exceeds 65°, and the ambient temperature is 25°. From the calculated values, applying a DC voltage of 200kV to the bushing results in a radial field strength of approximately 3.4kV/mm and an axial field strength of approximately 0.242kV/mm. The radial field strength is lower than the control value of 10kV/mm and the axial field strength is lower than the control value of 2.5kV/mm. Temperature value of 3D bushing could remain constant for about 2 hours. If the temperature remained constant, the dielectric loss factor(tanδ) can be inferred. There will be no change and it has indeed remained at 0.353% throughout the test, indicating good thermal stability of the bushing.

articleTitle: Application Research of Interactive Teaching Mode Based on AIGC generative Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: With the rapid development of Artificial Intelligence technology, especially the rise of AIGC (Artificial Intelligence Generated Content), the field of education is undergoing unprecedented changes. AIGC is an AI technology that can generate new and meaningful data or information. The core of AIGC is the fusion application of deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision and other technologies. This paper will conduct in-depth research on the interactive teaching mode based on AIGC from the aspects of theoretical basis and application scenarios, focusing on student-centered, promoting the transmission and internalization of knowledge through effective interaction and feedback between teachers and students. Pay attention to stimulate students' interest and initiative in learning, improve the teaching effect and learning experience. The purpose of this paper is to explore the interactive teaching mode based on AIGC generative artificial intelligence, analyze its application value and implementation strategy in teaching practice, and strive to promote the healthy development of AIGC technology in the field of education.

articleTitle: Research on customized clothing looseness algorithm using adaptive human body characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: In the process of customized clothing design, adding relaxation to clothing is an essential step to meet the daily activities of the human body, as well as the needs of wearing comfort and achieving a fitting effect. However, the traditional rule of adding relaxation to clothing is determined based on the experience of fashion designers; For example, its regulations generally add 18cm to the chest circumference of male T-shirts, and 6cm to the chest circumference of female T-shirts; The chest circumference of the jacket is generally increased by 23cm; The chest circumference of a windbreaker is generally increased by 24cm. The traditional rules for adding relaxation to clothing only consider the differences in clothing types and do not take into account the differences in human body shapes, which has certain limitations.To compensate for this deficiency, this paper proposes a three-dimensional clothing slack algorithm that adapts to the human body features. This algorithm not only considers the circumference size features of the human body, such as chest and waist, but also takes into account the wearing reference point features of the human body. The algorithm adds different amounts of clothing relaxation according to different body types.The customized clothing type studied in this article is short sleeved T-shirts, and the T-shirt sizes corresponding to different body types are divided into S, M, L, and XL sizes. The topic of this article stipulates that the corresponding body size for male T-shirts in size S is 160/80A, where 160 represents size, represents height, 80 represents type, represents chest circumference, and A represents body type classification; The male T-shirt size M corresponds to a body size of 165/84A; The male T-shirt size L corresponds to a body size of 170/84A; The male T-shirt XL corresponds to a body size of 175/88A; The female T-shirt size S corresponds to a body size of 155/80A; The female T-shirt size M corresponds to a body size of 160/84A; The female T-shirt size L corresponds to a body size of 165/84A; The XL size of a women's T-shirt corresponds to a body size of 170/84A.This article mainly studies the use of the USIP deep learning model to obtain the key points of the point cloud between the human body and clothing, and then obtain the reference points of the human body and clothing. The closest distance between the reference points of the human body and clothing is calculated. B-spline curve fitting is used to measure the circumference size of the human body and clothing, and a new formula for calculating clothing relaxation is proposed. Finally, simulation experiments are conducted based on different human body types.

articleTitle: Deep drug molecule generation model based on skeleton structure guidance and hybrid attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a deep generative model based on skeleton and considering stereochemical information of molecules, which characterizes molecules in the form of molecular diagrams, and generates new molecules by adding atoms and bonds sequentially to the skeleton diagrams using molecular skeleton and physicochemical properties as constraints. The model is capable of controlling multiple physicochemical properties of the molecule when generating the molecule, and has a multi-objective optimization function. In terms of model architecture: we use CVAE containing GRU to build the model, which consists of three parts: encoder (inference network), a priori network and decoder (generation network). In addition, in order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of the model, we combine a hybrid attention mechanism in the model: self-attention mechanism and external attention mechanism. The attention mechanism can automatically find the most informative feature points in the feature graph. Specifically, the attention mechanism can learn a task-oriented weighted feature graph and use it for subsequent representation learning. The validation results of the model performance show that: in terms of validity, uniqueness and novelty, the model has better validity and novelty than the pair-group model and good generalization ability; in terms of diversity, the diversity of the new molecules generated by the model is better than that of the molecules in the test set.

articleTitle: Research on User Side Photovoltaic-Energy Storage-Charging Configuration Strategy Based on Improved Deep Learning Algorithm and Its Engineering Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: At present, there are various types of energy storage on the user side, including the charging piles+energy storage, photovoltaic+energy storage, photovoltaic+charging piles+energy storage, etc. Each charging type has own characteristics. And for charging station applications currently distributed in urban centers, urban-rural integration areas, rural areas, and other application scenarios, there are significant differences in the utilization rate of electric vehicles on charging stations for each application scenario. In this article, the load of typical application scenarios is quantitatively calculated, and a certain capacity of energy storage equipment is configured in each application scenario to achieve the optimal ratio between load and energy storage capacity. This article divides into three types of regional features and effectively calculates the annual charging volume for each hour in each typical 24-hour period. Furthermore, the application scenarios will be extended to different scenarios such as photovoltaic, energy storage, and wind power, simulating the application benefits of integrated wind solar energy storage and charging projects. After obtaining 8760 hours of data on charging stations in each charging station, they were trained and learned through improved deep learning algorithms and RBF neural networks, which can be quantitatively characterized through the non specific function expressions. Specifically, for photovoltaic and photovoltaic power stations equipped with energy storage units, optimal ratio needs to be determined through intelligent algorithms to achieve maximum revenue. Furthermore, optimization strategy for the optical storage and charging configuration based on improved deep learning algorithms proposed in the article will be applied to specific engineering projects, and the profitability of the engineering projects will be quantitatively analyzed. The effectiveness of the proposed theoretical model will be demonstrated through specific data analysis.

articleTitle: Pruning Optimization of Deep Learning Model Based on Generalization Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Neural Networks (AIDLNN)
abstract: Existing research has shown that deep learning models contain considerable redundancy, requiring compression optimization to eliminate unnecessary parameters and improve computational efficiency. In model compression through pruning, many existing methods often use loss values to guide the identification of sub-network models. However, low training loss does not necessarily indicate good generalization ability. Consequently, reducing model parameters while preserving strong generalization performance has become a key area of research. Addressing the challenge of ensuring strong generalization performance of submodels after optimization through deep learning model pruning, we propose a channel-structured generalization estimation model. The model architecture incorporates Fully Connected Neural Networks (FCNN) and Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) as modules for channel feature extraction. Additionally, we introduce a differentiable pruning algorithm based on generalization estimation. Experimental results demonstrate the capability of the channel-structured generalization estimation model in predicting the generalization gap via regression. Furthermore, the proposed differentiable pruning algorithm effectively safeguards the generalization capability of sub-models. We conduct pruning experiments on NiN-structured convolutional neural network models on two datasets, CIFAR-10 and SVHN. Comparative experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach: achieving a 0.72% accuracy improvement over the original model on CIFAR-10; and a 0.12% accuracy improvement over the base model on SVHN while reducing FLOPs by 50.2%, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
